capital_methodology.voice: I would use Dataroma as a radar and the original 13F as evidence. If the share count changes, I would show the net change; if only its dollar value changes, I would not call that a purchase or sale.

capital_methodology.sample: I present a selected sample of managers and companies. I would treat it neither as a ranking of the entire market nor as a measure of pure exposure to each trend.
capital_methodology.needed_gap: A comprehensive corporate-action review for all issuers remains outstanding. The figures are presented as reported changes, not confirmed transactions. CRWD is explicitly excluded until the share basis at the June cutoff is resolved.
capital_methodology.snb: The SNB passively replicates broad indices. I would use its positions as evidence of institutional holdings, without attributing a favorable or unfavorable view on a trend to it.

vehicles.name: ABB
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study electrification and industrial automation.
vehicles.limitation: If I am seeking robotics exposure, I would review the business perimeter: the sale to SoftBank remains subject to conditions and faces a block on the Chinese business.

recent_changes.fact: ABB reported that China prohibited the acquisition of the robotics business in China. ABB and SoftBank were continuing to work on the transaction.
ABB delisted its ADRs from the NYSE; ABBNY is an OTC-traded ADR, not a NYSE listing.

vehicles.name: National Grid
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study energy grids and regulated assets in the United Kingdom and United States.
vehicles.limitation: If the grid expands, I would review regulated returns, financing and execution; more assets do not guarantee more value per share.

alternative_listings.instrument: ADS; each ADS represents five ordinary shares

vehicles.name: Iberdrola
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study electricity grids, generation and energy retailing.
vehicles.limitation: If growth is driven by investment, I would review debt, allowed returns and each geography’s contribution; the exposure goes beyond renewables.

vehicles.name: Stryker
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study medical technology, orthopedics, surgery and neurotechnology.
vehicles.limitation: If I am seeking longevity exposure, I would treat it as exposure to equipment and procedures; I would review hospital purchasing, regulation and integration costs.

vehicles.name: Thales
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study defense electronics, aerospace systems, cybersecurity and digital identity.
vehicles.limitation: If I attribute defense growth to it, I would separate its businesses and review its dependence on contract awards and system delivery.

vehicles.name: Rheinmetall
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study ammunition, military vehicles, air defense and other defense systems.
vehicles.limitation: If the order book grows, I would review delivery acceptance, industrial capacity and contract mix; the report itself describes sales shifting because of delays.

vehicles.name: Inditex
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study fashion retailing and the coordination of stores, digital commerce and logistics.
vehicles.limitation: If online sales grow, I would separate new sales from shifts between channels and review inventories and margin; fashion spending remains discretionary.

vehicles.name: LVMH
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study luxury brands, distribution and the ability to maintain prices.
vehicles.limitation: If I attribute brand power to it, I would review volumes, product mix and regional demand; its businesses do not all grow at the same pace.

vehicles.name: MercadoLibre
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study e-commerce, logistics and financial services in Latin America.
vehicles.limitation: If it grows, I would separate commerce from fintech and review credit, currencies and logistics spending; this is not exposure to the U.S. consumer.

vehicles.name: Ecolab
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study water treatment, hygiene and solutions for industrial and food-industry customers.
vehicles.limitation: If water demand rises, I would review which segment captures the revenue and the service and integration it requires; the group has several activities.

vehicles.name: Pentair
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study water equipment and solutions for residential, commercial and industrial applications.
vehicles.limitation: If I link it to water scarcity, I would separate swimming pools and the residential cycle from treatment and infrastructure; its segments may move in different directions.

vehicles.name: Airbus
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study space systems within Airbus Defence and Space.
vehicles.limitation: If I am seeking space exposure, I would separate that activity from the group: commercial aviation and helicopters carry significant weight, and Defence and Space is not exclusively space either.

vehicles.name: Albemarle
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study lithium and specialty chemicals within its current portfolio.
vehicles.limitation: If lithium prices rise, I would review costs, contracts and capital discipline; a recovery in the mineral does not translate into the same growth in earnings.

recent_changes.fact: The Q3 2026 report states that Albemarle sold a 51% interest in the Ketjen refining catalysts business; year-over-year comparisons require allowing for that change in business perimeter.

trends.trend_name: Education and the future of work

vehicles.name: Pearson
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study assessments, certifications and learning.
vehicles.limitation: If I assess AI’s impact, I would review contract renewals and the value of credentials; I would not assume that more digital use guarantees more revenue.

alternative_listings.instrument: ADR; each ADR represents one ordinary share according to the 2025 annual report

vehicles.name: VINCI
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study concessions, energy solutions and construction.
vehicles.limitation: If the order book grows, I would separate construction contracts from concessions and review traffic, financing and tax changes.

vehicles.name: Ferrovial
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study toll roads, airports and infrastructure development, with a strong presence in North America.
vehicles.limitation: If there are new projects, I would review committed capital, debt and traffic; I would distinguish Ferrovial’s economic interest from each asset’s total value.

recent_changes.fact: The Euronext Amsterdam delisting became effective. The company remains Dutch and is listed on Nasdaq and the Spanish stock exchanges.

vehicles.name: FANUC
vehicles.exposure: I would use it to study industrial robots, numerical controls, servomotors and automation machinery.
vehicles.limitation: If I am seeking robotics exposure, I would separate robots, factory automation and robomachines and review industrial orders and currency effects.

notes: I would use ticker and market together to avoid confusing ordinary shares, ADRs and data-provider symbols.
I would retain the limitations as my analytical reading. The references verify the listing, business and material changes; they are neither a valuation nor a recommendation.
I would not present ABBNY as a NYSE-listed security, or Ferrovial as currently listed in Amsterdam.
If I link candidates across trends, I would keep one company record to avoid duplicating capital movements.

political_disclosures.text: I would keep one layer for policy and legislation and another for transactions disclosed by public officials. If I include a transaction by Pelosi or another official, I would show the official document, beneficial owner, transaction date, publication date, amount range and asset class. I would neither attribute motives nor turn it into a buying signal. This package contains no reconstructed database of political transactions.
political_disclosures.publication_note: Before republishing disclosure data, I would review the document’s legal terms of use for this website.

capital_excluded_comparisons.reason: A 4-for-1 split occurred between the cutoffs, and the Q2 reporting basis remains unresolved. The implied value per share suggests that an adjustment may already have been incorporated; applying another factor could duplicate it.
capital_excluded_comparisons.ui_behavior: I would show the warning and original quantities without an arrow, a buying or selling color, a percentage or a ranking.

FB01.title: Generative AI is expected to magnify the risk of deepfakes and other fraud in banking
FB01.fact: Deloitte proyectó pérdidas estadounidenses por fraude habilitado por IA generativa de US$40.000 millones para 2027, frente a US$12.300 millones en 2023. Se construye asignando riesgo IA y escenarios de adopción a 26 tipos de fraude de IC3.
FB01.limit: Es una proyección de pérdidas, no una observación ni un porcentaje futuro de personas estafadas; no es un estudio firmado por JPMorgan.

FB02.title: 2025 IC3 Annual Report
FB02.fact: 22.364 quejas con descriptor AI Related y US$893.346.472 en pérdidas reportadas en 2025. La sección de IA está en la página impresa 39, página 39 del PDF.
FB02.limit: Quejas voluntarias; descriptor puede solaparse con criptomonedas y otros tipos. No son todas las pérdidas de IA ni número único de víctimas ni prevalencia poblacional.

FB03.title: Scam Victims Report Billions Lost and Harm to Mental Health
FB03.fact: 6% de adultos estadounidenses dicen haber sido estafados personalmente en 2025; 24% alguna vez en su vida adulta. Encuesta a 5.173 adultos del 8 de enero al 18 de febrero de 2026.
FB03.limit: Autorreporte y horizontes distintos. No son porcentajes de fraude atribuible a IA ni pronósticos. El 12% de IA procede de la cita del estudio en JPMorgan, no es visible en el artículo de Gallup abierto.

FB04.title: America needs a stronger scam prevention strategy
FB04.fact: El banco cita una encuesta Gallup/Stop Scams Alliance: consumidores reportaron IA o deepfake en alrededor del 12% de las estafas. Expone fragmentación de prevención y persecución entre canales, sectores y países.
FB04.limit: Es percepción reportada por encuestados; no una auditoría técnica de atribución IA. No proyecta un alto porcentaje futuro de la población.

FB05.title: FinCEN Alert on Fraud Schemes Involving Deepfake Media Targeting Financial Institutions
FB05.fact: Reporta incremento de SAR que describen deepfakes, incluidos documentos falsificados para eludir verificación de identidad. Aporta señales de alerta y obligaciones de reporte BSA.
FB05.limit: No cuantifica incidencia total ni prueba eficacia comercial de un proveedor.

FB06.publisher: Ministerio de Electrónica y TI de India
FB06.title: Government Strengthens Regulatory Framework to Address AI-Generated Deepfakes
FB06.fact: Expone las secciones 66C y 66D del IT Act sobre identidad y suplantación; BNS 319 sobre suplantación, 336 sobre falsificación y 111 sobre delincuencia organizada, además de obligaciones de intermediarios.
FB06.limit: Existencia de leyes no mide tasa de condena, recuperación de fondos ni aplicación efectiva transfronteriza.

FB07.title: The nexus between cybercrime and corruption
FB07.fact: Describe centros de estafas, lavado, corrupción, trata y uso de IA/deepfakes. Documenta expansión fuera del Sudeste Asiático y servicios conectados con varias regiones.
FB07.limit: No justifica imputar impunidad o delito a toda la población de un país.
